model: INMBSACA001I000 XYE-bus air conditioner to Modbus RTU interface (1 unit)
applies_to: INMBSACA001I000, user manual v1.8 EN; one indoor unit at unit address 0 on its own XYE bus.
summary: Small Modbus RTU slave that connects to the XYE bus of one VRF / commercial-line indoor unit. Holding registers give on/off, mode, fan, vane, setpoint and room temperature, alarms and error code, window-contact and remote-lock features, a Modbus-fed ambient temperature and run hours.

addressing.note: Tables give a 'protocol address' and a 'PLC address' (protocol + 1); the protocol address is the wire address and is used for 'documented'.

source.title: Intesis INMBSACA***I000 Modbus RTU (EIA-485) Interface for air conditioners - User Manual

notes: Every register is a 16-bit unsigned holding register per the manual. Temperature rows print an initialisation value of -32678 (some rows -32768, which is raw 0x8000 = 32768); -32678 looks like a typo for -32768 but the manual does not confirm it, so no marker value is given for those rows.

Temperatures follow DIP switch SW4: whole °C, decidegrees (x10) or °F. The register footnotes call x10 the default, but the SW4 table marks Celsius degrees as the factory setting, so scale 1 / °C is used here; with x10 selected use 0.1.
The baud-rate registers are left out: the manual lists the available rates but not the number that stands for each one.
The indoor unit must have unit address 0 in the AC system.
Error code list not reproduced; see the manual's error-code section.

registers.name: AC unit mode
registers.description: Available modes depend on the indoor unit.

registers.name: AC unit fan speed
registers.description: Available speeds depend on the indoor unit.

registers.name: AC unit temperature reference
registers.description: Temperature the unit controls on. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Window contact
registers.description: Virtual window contact written from Modbus.

registers.name: Remote control disablement
registers.description: Blocks the wired remote on the MD-RC bus. Non-volatile.

registers.name: AC unit operation time
registers.description: Hours the unit has been on, 0..65535. Non-volatile.

registers.name: Error code
registers.description: 0 = no error, 65535 = interface-to-unit communication error, other = unit error code.

values.65535: Interface to AC unit communication error

registers.name: Ambient temperature from external sensor
registers.description: Room temperature written from Modbus. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: AC real temperature setpoint
registers.description: Setpoint in use by the unit. SW4 x1 °C assumed (x10: 0.1, or °F).

registers.name: Block periodic sendings
registers.description: Blocked = commands only sent when the value changes.

integration.summary: Set the slave address and baud on SW3/SW4, set the indoor unit address to 0, then read and write holding registers 0..11. Check SW4 for the temperature format before scaling.
integration.enable: No enable step; register 7 must stay 0 (interface enabled).
quirks: All registers are unsigned 16-bit holding registers.
Error code 65535 (-1 signed) means the interface cannot talk to the indoor unit.
setup: Slave address and baud rate are set on DIP switches SW3/SW4 (factory: address 1, 9600 bps) and can be read back over Modbus.
The interface detects 8N2 or 8N1 framing by itself.
Changes to DIP switches need a power cycle.
Connect X / Y of the indoor unit's XYE bus to the interface (E is not used); the bus may be up to 1200 m.
SW1 sets the unit's features (Auto mode, Dry mode, fan Auto, 2 or 3 fan speeds).
gotchas: The interface needs the indoor unit powered before it starts communicating.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
